name: Tonalism
garments: not a fashion look — an American landscape-painting style
reacts_against: detailed, literal landscape realism, favoring soft, veiled, single-toned atmosphere (often blue-grey or brown twilight) over clear description.

findings: dark — about 53% of the measured color across 6 Commons photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 73% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Wikimedia Commons images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
